name: Campingplatz Königsdorf
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Königsdorf is situated in the idyllic Leukental valley, nestled between the Wilder Kaiser range and the Kitzbüheler Horn. The surrounding landscape provides premier conditions for hiking, cycling, winter cross-country skiing, and downhill skiing. Facilities include modern sanitary amenities, a fresh bread service, and generous pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. Convenient access via the B178 brings St. Johann in Tirol and Kitzbühel within swift reach.
